messages:
Sasha: Hey folks — weekend poll: thinking about hitting Golden Gate Park with my ukulele (bring snacks/blankets) or doing a one-day apartment deep clean (minimalist aspirations 😅). Who's in for which? :ukulele: :broom:
Alex: Ukulele 100% — weather looks good Sat morning. Also snacks > cleaning :joy:
Priya: I'm tempted to clean but would rather play ukulele and then nap. So team ukulele + I can bring coffee thermos ☕
Omar: Ukulele sounds fun. What time/where in the park? I'd only be free after 10:30.
Ben: If y'all end up cleaning, I can drop off my vacuum. But count me as a park + picnic vote. :raised_hands:
Jamie: I'm on call Sat morning until 11, so park after 11 works. Also down to bring a portable speaker.
Sasha: Cool — tentative plan: Sat 11:30 by the Willow Grove picnic table? If rain, fallback to 'cleaning day' at my place (I have snacks either way). Anyone want to bike there? :biking_man:
Priya: RSVP: +1. I'll bring muffins. Also quick poll — ukulele or open-mic? (I can play 2 songs) :guitar:
Alex: Ukulele + open-mic? Love it. :thumbsup:
events-bot: Note: there's a community yoga class in the park at 10:30. Might bump volume, bring ear-friendly tunes.
Omar: Sounds good. If anyone's allergic to dogs, FYI there's usually a dog meetup by the east lawn.
Ben: Noted re dogs. Also if we do cleaning, can we make it a swap: bring one thing to donate? :recycle:
Jamie: Love the swap idea. Either way — count me in. See you Sat!
Sasha: Awesome. I'll make a tiny Slack poll tomorrow AM. Thanks all :heart:
